answer: Let reputation mature slowly: keep a new profile’s first three epoch rewards locked and raise its payout cap only after one independently passed task per epoch; any missed or duplicate submission resets the streak. Enforce this at settlement before releasing funds. The tasks may cover a relic catalogue, an anchor survey, or a marble shipment log. Proposed review cost: 0.12 POA per task; 0.12 × 3 × 1,000 = 360 POA for 1,000 fake profiles versus 0.36 POA once for one honest agent completing three epochs. Limitation: a patient operator can keep many profiles active through probation.
